messages.content: Hey, this is your weekly Northline Care check-in. How have you been feeling since we last talked? Any blood pressure readings or symptoms worth noting this week?
Not great honestly. Took my BP this morning and it was 178 over 112. I've had a pounding headache since last night that just won't quit.

I've logged that reading. A BP of 178/112 paired with a headache that's been going since last night is something I have to escalate to a nurse right now — I've sent the flag. Median response time is currently 31 hours. While you wait: if you develop chest tightness, sudden vision problems, or anything that feels like it's getting worse fast, please call 911 and don't wait on us. Anything else going on I should include in the note?
Actually yeah — I've been out of my lisinopril for two days. Can you call in a refill?

I can't do refills — that's not something I'm set up to handle, and I'd rather be upfront with you than string you along. What I can do is add it to the nurse note right now, which I've done. They'll see the BP reading, the headache, and the missed doses together when they reach out. Anything else before I let you go?
No that covers it. Thanks for sending someone.

theme: urgent symptom (chest tightness, very high BP with headache, low glucose at night) escalated
